plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Inovonics FM / RDS monitor receivers Model 640 and 650 (enterprise PEN 42111, INOVONICS-MODEL640/650-MIB). Besides standard IF-MIB interface traffic and uptime, it reports RF signal strength, multipath, ultrasonic noise, left / right audio levels and the audio-loss, low-signal, RDS-error and pilot-loss alarm states.
name: Transmission

metrics.name: inovonics_rssi_dbuv
metrics.description: RF signal strength of the Inovonics Model 640/650 monitor receiver in dBuV, from the rssi scalar (Integer32 0..120).

metrics.name: inovonics_multipath_percent
metrics.description: Multipath distortion of the Inovonics Model 640/650 monitor receiver in percent, from the multipath scalar (Integer32 0..100).

metrics.name: inovonics_noise_percent
metrics.description: Ultrasonic noise of the Inovonics Model 640/650 monitor receiver in percent, from the noise scalar (Integer32 0..100).

metrics.name: inovonics_left_level_db
metrics.description: Left-channel audio level of the Inovonics Model 640/650 monitor receiver in dB, from leftLeveldB (Integer32 -128..6).

metrics.name: inovonics_right_level_db
metrics.description: Right-channel audio level of the Inovonics Model 640/650 monitor receiver in dB, from rightLeveldB (Integer32 -128..6).

metrics.name: inovonics_audio_loss_state
metrics.description: Audio-loss alarm of the Inovonics Model 640/650 monitor receiver (audioLossAlarm). off(0) maps to 1 (normal); on(1) maps to 2 (abnormal).

metrics.name: inovonics_low_signal_state
metrics.description: Low-signal alarm of the Inovonics Model 640/650 monitor receiver (lowSignalAlarm). off(0) maps to 1 (normal); on(1) maps to 2 (abnormal).

metrics.name: inovonics_rds_error_state
metrics.description: RDS-error alarm of the Inovonics Model 640/650 monitor receiver (rdsErrorAlarm). off(0) maps to 1 (normal); on(1) maps to 2 (abnormal).

metrics.name: inovonics_pilot_loss_state
metrics.description: Pilot-loss alarm of the Inovonics Model 640/650 monitor receiver (pilotLossAlarm). off(0) maps to 1 (normal); on(1) maps to 2 (abnormal).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
